newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Sarakreek buys Eastern Realty Inv. Corp.
newsitem.headline: Sarakreek buys Eastern Realty Inv. Corp.

text.p: Dutch property investment fund Sarakreek Holding NV said it had agreed to buy Eastern Realty Investment Corp (ERIC) in the U.S. from Britain's Electricity Supply Pension Scheme.
"The total transaction is valued at more than $185 million," Sarakreek said in a statement.
ERIC owns the L'Enfant Plaza building in Washington D.C. which has 642,000 square feet of office space, 163,300 square feet of shops, a hotel, storage space and a garage.
Sarakreek said the bulk of the deal, which was first announced last September, would be financed through loans totalling more than $150 million provided by investment bank Paine Webber.
Another $15 million will be provided by units linked to Tiger/Westbrook Real Estate Fund, which holds a controlling stake in Sarakreek.

Sarakreek said the takeover of ERIC and a recent refinancing of an office building the Dutch group owns in New York are expected to improve its balance sheet and increase net asset value and income in 1997.
